_readme: SAMPLE quotes written for the design sample. They are not from real customers. Replace with real, permissioned customer quotes or delete before launch (the launch gate blocks 'sample').

testimonials.quote: Blew a steer tire on I-635 after dark. One call, and someone was on the way. Honest about the price, too.
testimonials.name: Marcus T.

testimonials.quote: They found an air leak two other shops missed. Explained it, fixed it, and I was back out the same day.
testimonials.name: Danielle R.

testimonials.quote: The annual inspection took the guesswork out. A clear list of what passed and what needed work.
testimonials.name: Luis M.

testimonials.quote: Our trailers come back road-ready every time. Doors, lights, landing gear, all handled.
testimonials.name: Pat K.

testimonials.quote: Pulled in with a check-engine light and a derate. They traced it to a sensor instead of just swapping parts.
testimonials.name: Andre W.

testimonials.quote: Friendly, straightforward, and they call when they say they will.
testimonials.name: Tonya B.
